scenario: Operation DarkFrame: Simulated zero-day unauthenticated heap buffer overflow (CVE-2026-49120) in SEG-5000 Edge Gateway netframed binary actively exploited in the wild across EU Member States.
awareness_reasoning: Technical triage confirmed unauthenticated RCE via heap corruption in netframed v3.4.0 and matching PCAP reverse shell traffic from customer SOC in Germany.
csirt_determination_basis: Article 14(7) Main Establishment rule: corporate headquarters and strategic cybersecurity engineering decisions predominantly taken in Dublin, Ireland.

deadlines.final_report_rule: No later than 14 days after a corrective or mitigating measure is available (Article 14(2)(c)).

steps.notes: Legal awareness formally established and signed by CISO within 2 hours of telemetry ingress.

steps.step: Article 14(2)(a) Early Warning Formulation & Delayed Dissemination Request
steps.notes: Affected Member States identified (DE, FR, IE, NL). Delayed dissemination requested under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/881.

steps.step: Simulated ENISA SRP Early Warning Submission
steps.notes: Simulated submission completed 12 hours ahead of statutory 24-hour deadline.

steps.step: CVD Intake Response & Safe Harbor Acknowledgment
steps.notes: Responded to external researcher PoC within 2 hours under RFC 9116 and Legal Safe Harbor.

steps.step: Article 14(8) Proportional Customer Security Advisory (CSAF 2.0 / OpenVEX)
steps.notes: Emergency iptables firewall workaround published to customer portal without weaponization disclosures.

steps.step: Article 14(2)(b) Detailed Notification Submission to ENISA SRP
steps.notes: Submitted root-cause CWE-122 analysis, CVSS 10.0 vector, and TLP:AMBER+STRICT grading 18 hours ahead of 72h limit.

steps.step: Hotfix v3.4.1 Engineering, Pre-Release ASan Testing & Ed25519 Signing
steps.notes: Pre-release testing verified zero regressions; Ed25519 signature generated; free OTA distribution deployed.
Submitted sanitized patch to upstream open-source libframenet project maintainer.

steps.step: Simulated ENISA SRP 14-Day Final Report Submission
steps.notes: Final post-mortem and mitigation dossier submitted 9 days ahead of statutory 14-day limit.

user_information_step: Customer advisory ADV-2026-0042 distributed via authenticated portal within 29 hours of awareness; final update distributed free of charge via OTA.
findings: PAR and SAR delegation rota functioned with zero friction during simulated off-hours escalation.
Customer portal automated CSAF distribution requires integration with SIEM webhook in Q1 2027.
Article 13(6) upstream open-source coordination workflow operated smoothly without premature disclosure.
